solution.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud — Workload Protection Plans (CWPP)

products.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud — Workload Protection Plans (CWPP) — Commercial
products.short_description: Protect the workloads, not just the posture — enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud's workload protection plans across servers, containers, databases, and storage.
products.description:
Protect the workloads, not just the posture — enable Microsoft Defender for Cloud's workload protection plans across servers, containers, databases, and storage.

CSPM tells you what's misconfigured; workload protection (CWPP) catches what's actively attacking. This solution enables Defender for Cloud's workload plans — Servers (with MDE integration), Containers (AKS/registry), Databases (SQL/OSS/Cosmos), Storage, Key Vault, and App Service — with tuned alerts and a response workflow. Complements the existing Defender for Cloud CSPM solution.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Defender for Servers (P1/P2) with Defender for Endpoint integration
  • Defender for Containers (AKS + registry scanning + runtime)
  • Defender for Databases (SQL, open-source, Cosmos DB) and Storage
  • Defender for Key Vault, App Service, and Resource Manager
  • Alert tuning, suppression rules, and a workload response workflow

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Active workload threat protection across servers, containers, databases, and storage — the CWPP layer on top of your CSPM posture.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDCWP-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness for enabling Microsoft Defender for Cloud workload
    • MDCWP-EnablePlans.ps1 — enable Defender for Cloud workload protection plans on a subscription
    • MDCWP-Hunt.ps1 — run the workload-alert validation KQL to confirm Defender for Cloud alerts
    • MDCWP-Report.ps1 — alert inventory + protected-resource (cost) report for Defender for Cloud
    • MDCWP-Validate.ps1 — targeted validation of Defender for Cloud workload-plan enablement

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
